title: Codec-bit count bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and let $n,s,C$ be nonnegative integers. If $|Q|+6k+5\le C$, then the number of codec-bit positions is at most $C(s+n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Boolean-alphabet Turing machine
